how_a_label_becomes_a_node: label -> analysis.names._normalize_name (lowercase, strip punctuation and accents, collapse whitespace) -> canonicalize (the `synonyms` map below) -> node_key. Prefer a `label` from this file verbatim. A label that normalises to a key not listed here mints a new node instead of failing, which is how one technique ends up split across two spellings.

nodes.key: escape to standing gave up back
nodes.label: Escape to Standing (gave up back)

nodes.key: sweep duck under to side control
nodes.label: Sweep (Duck Under to Side Control)

nodes.key: transitions from guard to mount or back mount
nodes.label: Transitions from Guard to Mount or Back Mount
